endangerment.comment: Zhuang, Nong (zhn-zhn) = 3 (Wider communication). Language of recognized nationality: Zhuang. Native to China, Nong became widespread around mid 19th-century during colonial period. Used in trade, agriculture, long epic songs, school, and local commerce.
